'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[cruise missile]]s at [[Kyiv Oblast]], [[Khmelnytskyi Oblast]], and [[Kirovohrad Oblast]] in [[Ukraine]]. [[Ukrainian Air Force|Air Force]] Commander [[Mykola Oleschuk]] says that 36 targets, including three [[Kalibr (missile family)|Kalibr]] and 33 [[Kh-55|Kh-101/Kh-55]] cruise missiles were shot down. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-strike-targets-three-ukrainian-regions-air-force-2023-07-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**[[Niger Armed Forces|Soldiers]] from [[Niger]]'s presidential guard detain [[President of Niger|President]] [[Mohamed Bazoum]] inside the [[Presidential Palace, Niamey|Presidential Palace]] in [[Niamey]]. Entrances to [[government of Niger|government]] ministries are also blocked. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/26/soldiers-holding-niger-president-inside-palace-security-sources (Al Jazeera)]
**Soldiers announce on [[state media|state television]] that President [[Mohamed Bazoum]] has been removed from power. The country's borders are closed and a nationwide [[curfew]] is declared. [https://www.examiner.com.au/story/8285246/niger-president-bazoum-has-been-removed-soldiers-say/ (''The Examiner'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/26/armed-troops-blockade-presidential-palace-in-niger-mohamed-bazoum (''The Guardian'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Egypt]] cancels American rapper [[Travis Scott]]’s upcoming concert at the [[Giza Pyramids]] over Scott's alleged promotion of [[Freemasonry]]. [https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/travis-scott-pyramids-of-giza-concert-egypt-canceled-1234795526/ (''Rolling Stone'')] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/07/18/Egypt-cancels-US-rapper-Travis-Scott-s-concert-over-alleged-promotion-of-Masonry (Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**At least six people are killed and thousands of others are displaced as [[Typhoon Doksuri (2023)|Typhoon Doksuri (Egay)]] makes [[landfall]] in [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippine-typhoon-doksuri-flooding-d947d242dbea944a28c5d65628af91b2 (AP)]
*The [[Shoei Kisen Kaisha]]-owned [[cargo ship]] ''Fremantle Highway'' with around 3,000 cars, en route from [[Germany]] to [[Egypt]], catches fire near [[Ameland]], [[Netherlands]]. One person is killed and 22 others on board are injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/car-carrier-still-burning-off-dutch-coast-hunt-cause-begins-2023-07-27/ (Reuters)]
*Twenty-three people are killed and several others are injured when a bus overturns in Ngeune Sarr, [[Louga Department]], [[Senegal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/senegal-bus-crash-kills-23-people-2023-07-26/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are killed, nearly a dozen are injured and one person is reported missing after a silo exploded in [[Palotina]], [[Paraná (state)| Paraná]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-eight-dead-after-silo-explosion-southern-brazil-2023-07-27/ (Reuters)]
'''International relations'''
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**[[Moldova]] orders the expulsion of 22 [[Russia]]n diplomats by August 15. Several days earlier, a journalist investigation alleged that Russia installed satellite dishes and antennae on its embassy rooftop that could be used for spying. [https://apnews.com/article/moldova-russian-embassy-cuts-diplomats-spying-chisinau-5a4e8efa9f278d73b1958ba238bd95d0 (AP)] [https://moldova.europalibera.org/a/numarul-diplomatilor-rusi-acreditati-la-chisinau-va-fi-redus-/32520595.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Malian constitutional referendum]]
**[[Mali]] downgrades the [[French language]] from [[official language]] to [[working language]] in accordance with the new constitution. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/07/26/mali-drops-french-as-official-language/ (Africanews)]
*American actor [[Kevin Spacey]] is acquitted of nine [[sexual assault]] [[criminal charge|charges]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/actor-kevin-spacey-acquitted-all-nine-sexual-offence-charges-london-trial-2023-07-26/ (Reuters)]
* The [[Taliban]] orders beauty salons in [[Afghanistan]] to close despite [[United Nations]] concern and rare public protests. [https://apnews.com/article/taliban-beauty-salon-ban-women-rights-66c7151465679565d6332b61bf18a584 (AP)]
*[[Andrew Malkinson]], a British victim of a miscarriage of justice, who was sentenced to a [[whole life tariff]] for attempted murder and rape and spent 17 years in prison, has his conviction [[Motion to quash|quashed]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/jul/26/appeal-court-overturns-manchester-rape-conviction-of-man-who-spent-17-years-in-jail-andrew-malkinson (''The Guardian'')]
'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Cambodian general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Cambodia|Cambodian prime minister]] [[Hun Sen]] announces his upcoming [[resignation]] after four decades in power, with his son [[Hun Manet]] succeeding him. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/cambodia-pm-hun-sen-step-down-3655281 (CNA)]

*[[Pentagon UFO videos]], [[David Grusch UFO whistleblower claims]]
**The [[United States House Committee on Oversight and Accountability]] holds a [[United States congressional hearing|congressional hearing]] on [[unidentified aerial phenomena]], amid claims from former intelligence official David Grusch that the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] is operating a clandestine retrieval program for crashed "[[Extraterrestrial life|non-human]]" craft.
